evidence.quote: We assessed the innate immune response to MRKAd5/HIV by profiling transcriptomes of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) isolated from seven Ad5 nAb seronegative individuals (Ad5 nAb titer ≤18; Ad5Neg) during the first week after vaccination, by gene-level analysis of Affymetrix exon microarrays.

name_in_paper: Agilent SurePrint G3 Human GE 8 × 60K microarray platform

evidence.quote: RNA from the MRKAd5 vs. YF-17D comparative in vitro study was analyzed using the Agilent SurePrint G3 Human GE 8 × 60K microarray platform (Agilent Technologies), essentially as described in ref. 17.
Quantitative real-time PCR was performed as described in ref. 17.

Next, we corroborated the differential expression of many cytokines and chemokines at the protein level using multiplex serum analyte analysis (Fig. 1D and Dataset S1, tab 6), detecting robust changes in serum levels of IP-10, I-TAC, monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1), and MCP-2, as well as immunoregulatory IL-10 and IL-1Ra.

name_in_paper: Lincoplex High Sensitivity kit / regular sensitivity kits on a Luminex 200

evidence.quote: Serum cytokine analysis was performed using the Lincoplex High Sensitivity kit (Millipore Cat# HSCYTO-60SPMX13) and regular sensitivity kits (Millipore Cat# MPXHCYTO60KPMX42, MPXHCYP2:00 PMX23, and MPXHCYP3-PMX9), according to the manufacturer’s instructions (Linco/Millipore), and samples were analyzed on a Luminex 200 (Luminex).

Finally, we validated the cellular trafficking responses predicted from the modular analysis by directly assessing circulating peripheral blood leukocyte concentrations (Fig. 1E and Dataset S1, tab 7), confirming vaccine-induced influx of monocytes and pronounced efflux of lymphocyte populations (T, B, and NK cells).

name_in_paper: Trucount tubes staining and flow cytometry

evidence.quote: Cells were fixed with PBS containing 1% paraformaldehyde and stored at 4 °C until analysis by flow cytometry.

name_in_paper: intracellular cytokine staining assay for Gag-specific CD8+ T-cell responses

evidence.quote: Based on the frequency of Gag-specific CD8+ T-cell responses detected at day 28 after one immunization (Fig. S3), we categorized vaccine recipients (n = 31) into high, moderate, or low responders.

name_in_paper: in vitro PBMC stimulation with MRKAd5 empty vector

evidence.quote: We profiled RNA from unstimulated PBMC and PBMC incubated for 24 h with MRKAd5 at a dose sufficient to induce robust cytokine responses (Fig. S1).

name_in_paper: in vitro PBMC stimulation with YF-17D

evidence.quote: For comparative in vitro profiling, 16 samples were analyzed: PBMC obtained from four Ad5 seronegative donors stimulated for 24 h with MRKAd5 empty vector at 60,000 particles per cell and GTS buffer mock control or YF-17D at 30 particles per cell and DMEM 2% (vol/vol) FCS buffer mock control.
